notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence medium): Benilla's events.rs/decode.rs is the full typed decode dispatch over ~205 opcodes. MSUI's counterpart is the Program.Net.cs dispatch switch plus per-feature parsers, which covers the large majority (update-object, movement, combat, loot, quest, mail, trade, vendor, trainer, party/raid, world states, cooldown snapshot). Missing families are concentrated in polish/feedback packets.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: The mechanical pre-pass missing-list for this entry is unreliable: SMSG_GROUP_DESTROYED, SMSG_GROUP_SET_LEADER, SMSG_GROUP_UNINVITE, SMSG_PARTY_COMMAND_RESULT, MSG_MINIMAP_PING, MSG_RAID_READY_CHECK, MSG_RAID_TARGET_UPDATE, SMSG_SPELL_COOLDOWN, SMSG_INIT_WORLD_STATES and SMSG_UPDATE_WORLD_STATE all have real handlers in Program.Net.cs despite being listed as missing. Other batches' pre-pass numbers deserve the same per-opcode re-verification.
